# 2.0.3

## Fixed

- Preserve editor blank-line spacing and originating Reading-mode paragraph margins in List Hover Breadcrumbs.
- Redraw static breadcrumb guides after individual rows reflow, keeping branches below wrapped parent text.
- Render breadcrumb footnotes as superscript links using the originating note's definitions and numbering.
- Prevent continuation-paragraph text from activating a breadcrumb when full-item activation is disabled.
- Align static guides and threads with native bullets before nested callouts, including icon-only callout titles.

## Validation

Automated browser regressions include an optional check using Obsidian 1.14.4's parser. Verification inside Obsidian desktop remains outstanding; see `docs/validation-2.0.3.md`.
